footnote.keyboard: Up and Down move between siblings, Left goes to the parent and Right to the first child. Home and End go to the first and last agent. Enter selects.
footnote.partial: ¹ Partial: part of this agent's data couldn't be read, so its tokens or files may be incomplete.
footnote.missingTeammates_one: {{count, integer}} teammate not found: the lead spawned it, but it isn't in the sessions list.
footnote.missingTeammates_other: {{count, integer}} teammates not found: the lead spawned them, but they aren't in the sessions list.
footnote.truncated: The lead's spawn and stop lists hit their cap, so more teammates may be missing.

notFound.heading: Session not found
notFound.body: beekeeper can't find this session. It may have been deleted.

unreadable.heading: Can't read this session
unreadable.body: beekeeper can't read this session's files. Check their permissions, then retry.

partial.missingTeammates: Some teammates the lead spawned weren't found, so a team total may be low.

inspector.label: Agent inspector
inspector.unreadable: beekeeper couldn't read this agent's transcript.

worktree.label: Worktree diff
worktree.uncommittedFilters: Uncommitted changes aren't included: this repository uses git filters, which beekeeper doesn't run.
worktree.uncommittedMismatch: Uncommitted changes aren't included: that folder isn't this agent's worktree of the repository.
worktree.uncommittedNoWorktree: Uncommitted changes aren't included: this agent's worktree folder wasn't found.
worktree.gitNotFound: Git isn't installed, so the diff isn't available.
worktree.gitTooOld: This version of git is too old to show the diff. Update git to see it.

failure.tooLarge: The diff is too large to show.
failure.timeout: Git took too long to produce the diff.
failure.tooMany: This session has too many worktree agents to diff them all.
failure.noBase: There's no base branch to compare with.

worktree.shared: Shares the worktree of subagent {{agent}} in the lead session, so its changes are part of that diff.
